history.overview: The Heartlands were once the cultural center of Dragorn civilization before the Muramite conquest.

timeline.name: Dragorn Prosperity
timeline.description: The Heartlands flourished as the Dragorn homeland, filled with villages and ceremonial sites.

timeline.name: Muramite Invasion
timeline.description: Muramite forces invaded Dranik, seizing the Heartlands and establishing encampments.

timeline.name: Discord Bleed
timeline.description: Discord energy seeped into the Heartlands from nearby ruptures, corrupting the land.

timeline.name: Resistance Uprising
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels launched guerrilla operations against Muramite occupiers.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: The Heartlands remain a contested warfront between Muramites and Dragorn resistance.
